stem.en: Seller A's supply curve and the market supply curve are drawn on one graph with the same scales. Which statement about the two curves is true?

text.en: The market supply curve slopes down, because more sellers means lower prices.
Both slope up, and the market supply curve is flatter.
The market supply curve is steeper, because it adds the supply of three sellers.
The two curves are the same line, because every seller follows the Law of Supply.

explanation.en: Both curves follow the Law of Supply, so both slope up. The market curve adds every seller, so the same rise in price brings a much bigger change in quantity: 6 to 18 kg against Seller A's 1 to 3 kg. That makes it flatter, not steeper.

hints.en: Compare how many kilograms each curve adds when the price rises from ₹50 to ₹150.
